lesson.meaning: To bring two or more separate things together to form one single thing.
examples: Drivers need to be careful when they merge onto the highway.
Our two departments will merge next month, so we'll all be working in one big team.
The company decided to merge with its biggest competitor to become stronger in the market.
Can you please merge these two reports into a single document before the meeting?
We tried to merge our ideas for the new project, but some points were difficult to combine.
lesson.memory_tip: Think of two rivers flowing into one – they merge!
